procedure.method: Recalculate percent_rank cross-sectional signal, top-20 portfolio, next-calendar-month gross return, monthly overlap turnover, and net return directly in SQL from the factor table, then compare with persisted result rows.
procedure.rank_method: PostgreSQL percent_rank ascending within each month, over non-null factor values.
procedure.selection: Score descending, symbol ascending tie-break, top 20 frozen before reading the forward outcome.
procedure.missing_outcome: Count selected forward outcomes after selection; any missing result invalidates the month/run; do not substitute rank 21.
procedure.cost: net_return = gross_return - 0.002 * turnover; this represents 20 bps per full turnover unit.

checks.conclusion: Persisted 20-bps monthly returns exactly match the independent SQL recalculation to floating-point precision over all 56 persisted months. August 2026 is intentionally absent because F&D's next-calendar-month adjusted close is missing.
Persisted 20-bps monthly returns match the independent SQL recalculation to floating-point precision over all 57 persisted months, including August 2026.

limitations: This verifies arithmetic and portfolio selection against the current stored factor panel, not source correctness.
The monthly universe is survivor-oriented and PIT SET/mai membership is not verified.
The dataset's exact factor-builder version, source daily input hash and corporate-action adjustment lineage remain unknown.
Two candidate arithmetic checks do not independently validate the other six formula implementations or prove predictive alpha.
Historical OOS and post-hoc windows have already been inspected; an untouched prospective paper period is required.
